blocks.text: This chapter teaches the main techniques for testing and debugging code so that programs work correctly. It explains why testing matters for reliable applications and the common kinds of programming error. It covers unit testing with Python's unittest and pytest modules, writing and running test cases, and debugging with breakpoints, watch expressions and step-by-step execution. It then explains exception handling, including several exception types, and finally profiling and optimisation to measure performance and find bottlenecks.

blocks.title: Testing and debugging
blocks.text: Testing is checking a program to make sure it works correctly and gives the expected output. Debugging is finding and fixing the errors (bugs) in a program.

blocks.prompt: What is the difference between testing and debugging?
blocks.explanation: Testing checks whether the program gives the expected results and reveals that something is wrong; debugging finds the cause of a known problem and fixes it.

items: Testing: does the program give the expected output?
Debugging: find and fix the bugs.
This chapter: unit tests, breakpoints, watches, exceptions, profiling.
